name: Field
import: import { Field, FieldLabel, FieldControl, FieldDescription, FieldError } from "@/components/ui/field"
description: A labelled form field that wires the label, description, error, and invalid state to its control automatically.

Field.description: The root. Wraps a label + control + optional description/error and links them.

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid — sets aria-invalid on the control and reveals the error.

name.description: Field name, forwarded to the control (useful with a form).

FieldError.description: The error message. Shown when it matches the field's validity.

match.description: true → always show (use for a custom message); or a validity key like "valueMissing".

forbidden: Do not hand-wire id/htmlFor/aria-describedby — Field does it. Just nest label + control.
Do not put a bare
Do not restyle text sizes/colors via className; they come from tokens.
Show an error with FieldError, not colour on the input alone.

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
